secondary.title: Witcher 3's New Expansion Pairs Geralt's Polish Voice Actor With AI, But It's A "Special Case"
CD Projekt used AI to modify the voice of Geralt's Polish actor after a stroke left it significantly changed: 'This was a special case'
The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past’s Polish Geralt VA will be tuned with AI due to the actor’s health concerns
The Witcher 3 Devs Explain Using AI To Help With Geralt’s Polish Voice In Songs Of The Past: ‘This Is One Of Those Ways Where You Can Use AI Ethically’
CD Projekt Red Used AI to Alter Geralt's Voice Due to Polish Actor's Health Issues

singleSourced.context:
CD Projekt Red's head of localization Mikołaj Szwed shared the following comment with Game File about this decision:

"I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically, with consent and also do something good".

If it's consent first and used in a good manner, I think it could be okay.

singleSourced.key: as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world this is a big concern
singleSourced.value: as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world, this is a big concern,
singleSourced.context: CD Projekt itself has been ambivalent about AI; localization producer Mikołaj Szwed told Game File that "as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world, this is a big concern," although he added that "this was a special case" caused by Rozenek's health problems.

singleSourced.key: as russell said rozenek s stroke created a more substantial change totilo said his untouched voice in the expansion
singleSourced.value: as Russell said, Rozenek's stroke created a more substantial change: Totilo said his untouched voice in the expansion
singleSourced.context: But while "the equipment changes," as Russell said, Rozenek's stroke created a more substantial change: Totilo said his untouched voice in the expansion "sounds deep and gravelly, noticeably rougher than his recordings for the original game," while the AI-edited voice is much closer to Rozenek's voice as it was a decade ago.
